items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A lot of guys, say like Clark Terry, they alternate, Freddy Hubbard too.

ctx.x: For those other flugelhornists or budding flugelhornists, can you talk about your instrument? Mouthpiece, etc.?

Yeah, the flugelhorn has a darker, wider sound than the trumpet. The negative thing is – as long as you stay within the perimeters of it, it’s okay – but basically, I’m a trumpet player and sometimes I feel like I want to play in that range. But the flugelhorn doesn’t work so well if you go into the high register. It sort of what we call pyramids, like if you’re in a low register, it’s this big, but the higher you go, the smaller the sound gets. So, you feel like somehow you’re missing something there.
